newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone dips as directors cash in options.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone dips as directors cash in options.

text.p: Shares in Vodafone Group Plc dipped in late trading on Wednesday as the mobile phone group said two of its directors, including finance director Kenneth Hydon, had cashed in share options.
The stock closed down 1/2p at 253 after earlier rising as high as 263p -- its highest since April -- in further reaction to yesterday's strong results and Peoples Phone acquisition.

Vodafone said Hydon sold 243,200 shares at 258p, leaving him with 195,048 shares excluding unexercised share options, while fellow director John Peett sold 163,800 shares at 260p to leave him with 299,199 shares, excluding further options.
